name: Ring of Spell Storing (minor)
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 174, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 174, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Aura faint evocation CL 5th
Slot ring; Price 18,000 gp; Weight —
Description
As the ring of spell storing, except it holds up to 3 levels of spells.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, imbue with spell ability; Cost 9,000 gp
